details:
Q1. Which area should be improved?
Choices:
A. Clarify / plan / implement pipeline behavior
B. Review / autofix / judge / conflict-resolution behavior
C. Orchestrator / validation / issue-status automation
D. Docs / prompts / workflow templates
E. Another specific source-repo or consumer-repo flow — name the workflow, script, file path, or repo in your /answer. (RECOMMENDED)
Q2. What kind of improvement do you want there?
Choices:
A. Fix a specific bug or regression — include the current behavior and expected behavior. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Improve reliability / safety / guardrails without changing intended behavior
C. Improve runtime / cost / performance
D. Improve docs / operator ergonomics / clarity
E. Other measurable outcome — describe the desired before/after result. (RECOMMENDED)
Q3. What concrete evidence or acceptance criteria should implementation use?
Choices:
A. A failing workflow run, PR, issue, or log example — include repo name plus link/number. (RECOMMENDED)
B. The exact workflow name(s), script path(s), or file path(s) that should change. (RECOMMENDED)
C. If there is no failing example, provide 2-3 acceptance bullets for what "done" should look like. (RECOMMENDED)
